canonicalization.instant: UTC RFC3339 with exactly nine fractional digits and Z
canonicalization.json: UTF-8 NFC strings; closed schemas; lexicographically ordered object keys; arrays preserve declared order; no insignificant whitespace
canonicalization.price_domain: positive integer price_units <= 2^127-1 and divisible by tick_size_price_units
canonicalization.quantity_domain: positive integer quantity_units <= 2^127-1 and divisible by lot_size_quantity_units

position_snapshot.version_rule: positive integer incremented exactly once in the same server persistence transaction as each mutation

exit_arithmetic.profit_protection: favorable_price_delta*r_denominator >= initial_risk_price_units*r_numerator using checked uint256 intermediates
exit_arithmetic.stop_move: entry_price_units plus zero ticks; entry is prevalidated tick aligned

scope_digest_frame: sort paths as UTF-8 bytes; for each append path, NUL, exact file bytes, NUL; SHA-256 the concatenation

algorithm: validate each key as the already-required NFC Unicode scalar sequence
encode each key to exact UTF-8 without BOM or replacement
compare unsigned bytes from index zero
first lower unequal byte sorts first
when all shared bytes are equal the shorter byte sequence sorts first
equal bytes denote equal keys and duplicate JSON keys are rejected

measurement_order: validate Unicode scalar sequence and count lossless UTF-8 bytes with checked arithmetic
validate closed schema and exact JSON primitive types
validate every parsed string as a Unicode scalar sequence then validate NFC and canonical raw serialization
resolve private policy and construct provenance
input_budget.overflow_behavior: stop fail-closed before integer overflow or immediately after establishing byte 65537
